title: Stop repeated rescheduling of Dataverse synch jobs on bulk changes
summary: The Dataverse synchronization job reschedule logic now checks both the scheduled task's next run time and the job queue entry's earliest start date to avoid repeated rescheduling during bulk changes, reducing unnecessary Service Bus costs.
key_points: Reschedule now also checks the job queue entry's Earliest Start Date/Time and skips jobs already due within the reschedule window
Job queue entry is locked before SetTaskReady, and status, task ID and earliest start are re-checked under the lock so concurrent sessions do not each reschedule
Reschedule loop moved into new internal procedure RescheduleJobQueueEntriesForTable so tests can call it
Targets telemetry showing one reschedule per changed record, which drove Service Bus cost
New tests cover moving a later job to about 30 seconds and not rescheduling again when the task's Not Before is stale
quote: If the job is already due within the reschedule window, skip it.
